title.original: From Inference Routing to Agent Orchestration: Declarative Policy Compilation with Cross-Layer Verification
title.zh: 从推理路由到智能体编排：具备跨层验证的声明式策略编译
title.en: From Inference Routing to Agent Orchestration: Declarative Policy Compilation with Cross-Layer Verification

inclusion_reason.zh: Semantic Router DSL 将同一可验证策略编译到推理、Agent、Kubernetes 和协议边界，是跨层控制基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: The Semantic Router DSL compiles one verifiable policy into inference, agent, Kubernetes, and protocol-boundary targets, making it cross-layer control infrastructure.

abstract.zh: 该论文把生产推理路由使用的 Semantic Router DSL 扩展到多步 Agent 编排和基础设施策略。一个非图灵完备的声明源可同时编译为 LangGraph/OpenClaw 决策节点、Kubernetes 策略、YANG/NETCONF 配置及 MCP/A2A 边界门。
abstract.en: This paper extends the production Semantic Router DSL from per-request inference routing to multi-step orchestration and infrastructure policy. One non-Turing-complete source compiles to LangGraph/OpenClaw decision nodes, Kubernetes policy, YANG/NETCONF payloads, and MCP/A2A boundary gates.

problem.zh: 模型网关、Agent 图、协议门和集群策略由不同团队维护时，同一隐私或安全阈值会跨层漂移，审计轨迹也难与实际决策逻辑保持一致。
problem.en: When model gateways, agent graphs, protocol gates, and cluster policy are maintained separately, privacy and safety thresholds drift across layers and audit traces diverge from executed logic.

approach.zh: DSL 用内容信号、加权投影和有优先级决策树描述策略；编译器复用同一信号定义生成各层目标，并静态检查分支冲突、穷尽性和引用完整性。
approach.en: The DSL expresses policy through content signals, weighted projections, and prioritized decision trees; a compiler reuses signal definitions across targets and statically checks conflicts, exhaustiveness, and referential integrity.

system_design.zh: 编译前端构建可验证策略 IR，后端分别发射编排节点、NetworkPolicy/Sandbox CRD/ConfigMap、网络设备配置和协议边界检查；审计事件由同一决策树结构生成。
system_design.en: A compiler front end builds a verifiable policy IR; target back ends emit orchestration nodes, NetworkPolicy/Sandbox CRD/ConfigMap resources, network-device payloads, and protocol gates, with audit events generated from the same decision tree.

key_results.zh: 论文给出跨层策略编译体系，并基于语言限制声明路由穷尽、分支无冲突、引用完整及审计与决策结构耦合等保证；摘要未提供性能基准。
key_results.en: The paper presents a cross-layer compilation system and, through language restrictions, claims exhaustive routing, conflict-free branching, referential integrity, and structurally coupled audit traces; no performance benchmark is reported in the abstract.

limitations.zh: 非图灵完备提升可验证性但限制动态策略表达；静态保证依赖信号实现和各后端语义正确，无法证明运行时分类器、集群或外部协议本身无错。
limitations.en: Non-Turing-completeness aids verification but limits dynamic expressiveness; guarantees depend on correct signal implementations and target semantics and cannot prove runtime classifiers, clusters, or external protocols correct.

metrics.name: static guarantees
metrics.value: exhaustive routing, conflict-free branching, referential integrity, and coupled audit traces

notes.zh: 部署目标和静态保证来自官方摘要；摘要未给出性能、规模、模型或硬件实验，证明细节与各后端验证待全文审计。
notes.en: Deployment targets and static guarantees come from the official abstract; it reports no performance, scale, model, or hardware experiment, and proof details and target validation await full-text audit.
